notes: Both Sh tokens (s008, s012) sit on imperatives and are cohortative/paragogic he, not the Sd directive he, so both are unrepresented under rule 32.

'upon thee' and 'ear unto my voice' both divide by rule 44: the preposition the English verb's valency needs to reach its own object — a bare object suffix at s006, a bare object noun at s013 — stays with the verb, while the suffix and the noun keep only their own words.
s015/s017 follow rules 52 and 18: the temporal בְּ takes 'when' and the suffix on the infinitive construct is its subject, taking 'I'.
